record.hypothesis: For all four datasets, increase embedding width from 64 to 96, retaining two attention heads, tied history/candidate item embeddings, zero padding and existing initialization and normalization rules. Greater representation capacity may distinguish overlapping item interests without the norm compression that previously regressed. Propagate width consistently through existing HSTU layers and positional embeddings without changing block topology, features, history/readout policy, dot-product scoring, loss or optimizer. Save matching metadata and update the predictor writer.

category_rationales.rationale: Increase embedding width from 64 to 96 across all four category models to test greater representation capacity. Preserve two attention heads, tied item embeddings, initialization, normalization, HSTU topology, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer. Existing metadata saves the configured width, and the predictor writer already loads that width explicitly, keeping checkpoints and inference consistent.
